about: The converge engine's cost on the G9a smoke (feature-parity decision 7), checked by .github/workflows/go.yml against converge.jsonl. Each Target run on the successful path with changesPerRun values makes the commits in points (2k + 7) in that order; with every commit alone in its batch it writes walBytesPerTarget bytes to the WAL (4096-byte pages, 24-byte frame headers). Under the load a commit may share its batch with disclosures and report its share, so the run's median Target must stay within walMedian times the baseline and each Target within walEach. A pull request that changes the engine's cost on purpose updates this file and says why in its body (decision 7: more than 20 % more commits or WAL bytes per run needs a reason). Measured 2026-11-17 (varlatch#238): 17 commits per Target, 131840 bytes alone, a median of 152440 under the smoke's load.
